roles.note: SOP-851-12 Rev C responsibilities. Supersedes the generic Preparer/Reviewer/Admin model.
roles.orderAdminSales: Identify potential sales or ordered parts requiring PMA (Power BI report); notify Quality if parts are not reflected.
roles.qualityControl: Request and collect the TC or STC information, complete the supplement per SOP-851-12, and have it reviewed by a third person.
roles.vicePresidentQuality: Review and sign the form and submit it to the FAA office.
